inlines.v: ACCRUE, verb intransitive accru'. [Latin accresco, cresco.] Literally, to grow to; hence to arise, proceed or come; to be added, as increase, profit or damage; as, a profit accrues to government from the coinage of copper; a loss accrues from the coinage of gold and silver. ACCRUE, noun accru'. Something that accedes to, or follows the property of another. obsolete
